name: Bear Shaman
summary: A shaman with this focus calls upon the mighty bear, titan of the woodlands and mountains, a paragon of strength and ferocity, and yet also a quiet protector rich in wisdom.

features.name: Nature Bond
features.summary: A bear shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a bear. If choosing a domain, the bear shaman must choose from the Animal, Earth, Protection, and Strength domains.

features.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
features.summary: A bear shaman can use wild empathy with bears and wolverines as a full-round action with a +4 bonus.

features.name: Totem Transformation (Su)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a bear shaman may adopt an aspect of the bear while retaining her normal form. She gains one of the following bonuses: movement (+10 enhancement bonus to land speed, +4 racial bonus on Swim checks), senses (low-light vision, scent), toughness (+2 natural armor bonus to AC, Endurance feat), or natural weapons (bite [1d6] and 2 claws [1d4] for a Medium shaman, +2 to CMB on grapple checks). While using totem transformation, the bear shaman may speak normally and can cast speak with animals (mammals only) at will. Using this ability is a standard action at 2nd level, a move action at 7th level, and a swift action at 12th level. The bear shaman can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to her druid level. These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be used in 1-minute increments. This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as wild shape.

modes.label: Movement

modes.label: Toughness
modes.summary: +2 natural armor bonus to AC. Gain Endurance while this aspect is active.

activeEffects.description: Gain Endurance while this aspect is active.

modes.summary: Gain a bite (1d6), two claws (1d4), and +2 CMB to grapple.

activeEffects.description: Gain a bite (1d6), two claws (1d4), and +2 CMB to grapple.

confirmations.label: The target is one of the permitted bears

resourceActions.summary: At-will speak with animals, restricted to bears.

features.name: Totemic Summons (Su)
features.summary: At 5th level, a bear shaman may cast summon nature’s ally as a standard action when summoning bears, and summoned bears gain temporary hit points equal to her druid level. She can apply the young template to any bear to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the advanced or the giant template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates. This ability replaces a thousand faces.

resourceActions.label: Resolve Totemic Summons

modes.label: Young (spell level -1)
modes.summary: Apply the young template and reduce the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Normal
modes.summary: Use the normal summon spell level.

modes.label: Advanced (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the advanced template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Giant (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the giant template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Advanced + giant (spell level +2)
modes.summary: Apply both templates and increase the required summon spell level by 2.

activeEffect.name: Bear Shaman Totemic Summons
activeEffect.description: Summoned bears gain temporary hit points equal to your druid level; track their summon duration separately.

resourceActions.summary: Cast summon nature's ally as a standard action for bears; summoned creatures gain temporary hit points equal to druid level.

features.name: Wild Shape (Su)
features.summary: At 6th level, a bear shaman’s wild shape ability functions at her druid level – 2. If she takes on the form of a bear, she instead uses her druid level + 2. This ability replaces wild shape.

resourceActions.label: Assume Shaman Wild Shape

activeEffects.label: Favored wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level +2.

activeEffects.label: Adjusted wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level -2.

resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 wild shape use and track the correct effective druid level for the selected form.

progressionProfiles.label: Wild Shape Effective Level
progressionProfiles.summary: Effective druid levels used by normal and totem-favored wild shape forms.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, a bear shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: Diehard, Endurance, Great Fortitude, Improved Great Fortitude, Toughness. She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats. This ability replaces venom immunity.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 13th level, a bear shaman gains another feat from her totem bonus feat list.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 17th level, a bear shaman gains another feat from her totem bonus feat list.

mechanicalNotes: Nature Bond restrictions, Wild Empathy, daily transformation minutes, aspect modes, at-will animal speech, template-aware summons, effective wild-shape levels, and all bonus-feat slots are automated.
